title: [確認しよう] LEFT JOINで左の表を残す
statement: customers と orders を LEFT JOIN し、すべての顧客について customer_name と order_id を表示してください。注文がない顧客も残し、その order_id は空にします。

constraints.name: 並び順
constraints.value: customer id、order id の昇順です

starterSql:
SELECT
  customers.name AS customer_name,
  orders.id AS order_id
FROM customers
LEFT JOIN orders
  ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
ORDER BY customers.id ASC, orders.id ASC;
solutionSql:
SELECT
  customers.name AS customer_name,
  orders.id AS order_id
FROM customers
LEFT JOIN orders
  ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
ORDER BY customers.id ASC, orders.id ASC;
